subject: Parking Permit Expiring Soon - $permit_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

Your parking permit is expiring soon!

Permit ID: $permit_id
Zone: $zone
Expiration Date: $end_date
Days Remaining: $days_remaining

To avoid parking violations and continue parking on campus, please renew your permit before it expires.

Renewal Options:
1. Online: Visit https://university.edu/parking/renew
2. In Person: Parking Services Office (Student Services Building, Room 120)
3. By Phone: Call (555) 123-4567

Renewal Requirements:
- Valid student ID or staff credentials
- Vehicle registration information
- Payment (credit/debit card or student account)

Don't wait until the last minute! Renew today to ensure uninterrupted parking access.

If you no longer need a parking permit, no action is required.

$signature
